mapper.insert: INSERT INTO device (device_id, device_type, device_name, manufacturer, model, install_date, status, zone, params, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{deviceId}, #{deviceType}, #{deviceName}, #{manufacturer}, #{model}, #{installDate}, #{status}, #{zone}, #{params}, datetime('now', 'localtime'), datetime('now', 'localtime'))
mapper.update: UPDATE device SET device_name = #{deviceName}, manufacturer = #{manufacturer}, model = #{model}, install_date = #{installDate}, zone = #{zone}, update_time = datetime('now', 'localtime') WHERE device_id = #{deviceId}
mapper.select: SELECT device_id, device_type, device_name, manufacturer, model, install_date, status, zone, params, create_time, update_time FROM device WHERE device_id = #{deviceId}

SELECT device_id, device_type, device_name, manufacturer, model, install_date, status, zone, params, create_time, update_time FROM device
ORDER BY device_id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT device_id, device_type, device_name, manufacturer, model, install_date, status, zone, params, create_time, update_time FROM device ORDER BY zone, device_id
SELECT device_id FROM device WHERE device_id LIKE #{prefix} || '-%'
